fuzz.seeds: actual admitted original Bold and abc; grouped/cancel/repeat/repair/block command sequences; maximum token body; labelled opaque inner-code lookalike and truncated header
fuzz.invariants: no panic, caller/source mutation, partial failure, mutated old document/cursor/history/preview snapshots, false qualified output, lost raw fragments, exceeding limits or unrelated prefix changes

work: No recursion; pair scan linear <=16384 tokens; three-entry transitions fixed; native candidate validates through unchanged reader plus same admission; preview <=4096 elements and <=4 code-position checks per fragment token. Repeated client commands are capped64 by the harness; no product latency or total editing-session SLO inferred.
allocation: History stores at most three owned raw fragments/kind arrays and their short code-position arrays, not per-character chains of old document revisions. Current document state/source and private result/preview snapshots remain immutable. Caller-retained old values naturally retain their own data; no global history registry/cache. Inherited broad read-only Inspect metadata cost remains separate from admitted mutation cost. Final measurements will report B/op and harness RSS, not pretend hard peak-live caps.
